# Management UI

> A modular, plugin-based video content management system for educational institutions.
> Built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, and shadcn/ui.
> Monorepo managed with pnpm + Turborepo.

## Architecture

Three-layer monorepo: apps (domain UIs), packages (shared infrastructure), plugins (extension system).

### Apps (`apps/`)
- `management-ui-core` — Main application shell, plugin orchestrator, layout
- `management-ui-series` — Video series management
- `management-ui-episodes` — Episode management
- `management-ui-upload` — Content upload and processing

### Packages (`packages/`) — Dependency Layers
```
Layer 3 (Application):  app-runtime, providers, vite-config, ui-config
Layer 2 (Integration):  query, router, ui, remote-plugin-loader
Layer 1 (Foundation):   plugin-system, store, i18n
Layer 0 (Core):         utils, typescript-config, eslint-config, tailwind-config
```
Lower layers NEVER depend on higher layers.

### Plugins (`plugins/`)
- `plugins/core/` — Mandatory extension points and defaults (always loaded)
- `plugins/admin-marketplace/` — Optional shared plugin (marketplace UI)
- `plugins/admin-dashboard/` — Optional shared plugin (admin dashboard)
- `plugins/community-plugin-template/` — Starter template for new plugins

### External Plugins (`.local-plugins/` or separate repos)
Org-specific plugins live outside the core repo. In dev, they go in `.local-plugins/<name>/`.
In production, they are deployed as OSGi JARs or loaded from a registry/CDN.

### Scaffold Commands

- `pnpm plugin:create-local <name> --wire-config` — New plugin from template
- `pnpm plugin:extract <org>/<module> --name <new-name>` — Extract module to standalone plugin
- `pnpm plugin:export-local <name>` — Move built-in plugin to `.local-plugins/`
- `pnpm validate:plugins` — Validate all `plugin.json` manifests

## Plugin System

### Creating a Plugin

Every plugin is an ES module that default-exports a plugin object. Per-feature
source is organized under `modules/<area>/` (not legacy `implementations/`).

```typescript
import { createPlugin } from "@workspace/plugin-system";

export default createPlugin({
  namespace: "my-org", // WHO provides it: org or feature name
  type: "app", // WHAT it is: role/slot, never mechanism
  version: "1.0.0",
  initialize(manager) {
    manager.registerObject("apps:definitions", "my-org:my-app", {
      id: "my-org-app",
      name: "My App",
      routePath: "/my-org",
      component: MyAppComponent,
    });
    manager.registerObject("sidebar:nav-items", "my-org:nav", {
      title: "My App",
      path: "/my-org",
      icon: LayoutDashboard,
      order: 100,
    });
  },
  activate() {},
  deactivate() {},
});
```

### Plugin Manifest (`plugin.json`)

Every plugin should have a `plugin.json` in its root. Schema at:
`packages/plugin-system/src/schemas/plugin.schema.json`

Key fields: `id`, `name`, `version`, `namespace`, `type`, `apiVersion`,
`entry`, `css`, `modules` (for multi-entry), `workspaceDependencies`.

### Extension Points

Registration pattern: `manager.registerObject(extensionPoint, uniqueId, value)`
or `manager.registerComponent(extensionPoint, Component, options)`

Core extension points:
- `apps:definitions` — Register a routable app (id, name, routePath, component)
- `sidebar:nav-items` — Register sidebar navigation (title, path, icon, order)
- `component-override:landing-page` — Override the landing page
- `component-override:appshell:header` — Override the app header
- `component-override:appshell:footer` — Override the app footer
- `app:config` — Register configuration (pluginNamespace, theme, branding)
- `app:branding` — Register branding (logo, colors, favicon)

### Two-Phase Loading

The runtime loads plugins in two phases:
1. Phase 1: Load `*:config` plugins first (they register `app:config`)
2. Phase 2: Merge config, then load remaining plugins filtered by `pluginNamespace`

This allows a config plugin (e.g., `.local-plugins/config/`) to declare which
namespaces to enable (e.g., `pluginNamespace: ["core", "univie", "tuwien"]`),
and those plugins load in phase 2.

### Loading Mechanisms

1. Built-in — Exported from `plugins/index.ts`, bundled with core
2. JAR — Backend scans OSGi bundles, exposes `plugins.json`, core loads them
3. `.local-plugins` — Dev-only: Vite serves `dist/*.mjs` with manifest
4. Marketplace/Registry — Community plugins loaded from CDN URLs
5. localStorage — Developer mode: manually entered URLs

### Multi-Entry Plugins

One plugin package can contain multiple modules (e.g., app + sidebar + footer).
In `plugin.json`, use the `modules` array. Each module has its own `type` and
`entry`, and can be activated independently via `pluginNamespace` type filtering:
```json
{ "univie": { "types": ["sidebar", "footer"] } }
```

## Styling Contract

Plugins MUST use semantic CSS tokens from the shared design system. This ensures
plugins automatically match any org's theme without hardcoded colors.

### Required: Use Semantic Tokens

Use Tailwind classes that reference CSS custom properties:
- `bg-background`, `text-foreground` — Page background/text
- `bg-primary`, `text-primary-foreground` — Primary actions
- `bg-secondary`, `text-secondary-foreground` — Secondary surfaces
- `bg-muted`, `text-muted-foreground` — Subdued content
- `bg-card`, `text-card-foreground` — Card surfaces
- `bg-destructive` — Destructive actions
- `border-border`, `ring-ring` — Borders and focus rings
- `bg-sidebar`, `text-sidebar-foreground` — Sidebar-specific

### Forbidden: Hardcoded Colors

Never use hardcoded hex/rgb/oklch values in plugin code. Always use semantic tokens.

### Use Shared UI Components

Import from `@workspace/ui/components` (shadcn/ui based):
Button, Card, Input, Select, Dialog, Table, Tabs, Badge, etc.

### Plugin CSS

- Plugin CSS is loaded BEFORE host CSS (intentional, prevents override conflicts)
- Use explicit Tailwind layers: `@layer theme, base, components, utilities, plugin-overrides`
- Scope overrides with plugin-specific selectors, not load-order tricks
- For theming changes, override CSS custom properties, not component classes

Full contract: `docs/PLUGIN_STYLING_CONTRACT.md`
Token reference: `packages/ui/src/styles/globals.css`

## Data Fetching

Use GraphQL hooks from `@workspace/query`. Never mock data in production plugins.

```typescript
import { useGetMyEventsQuery } from "@workspace/query";
const { data, isLoading } = useGetMyEventsQuery({ limit: 20 });
const events = (data?.currentUser?.myEvents?.nodes || [])
  .filter((e): e is NonNullable<typeof e> => e !== null);
```

## i18n

Plugins ship their own locale files under `locales/<namespace>/<lng>.json`.
Use `useI18n()` from `@workspace/i18n` with namespaced keys: `t("my-plugin:title")`.

## Common Mistakes

1. Registering an app without a sidebar nav item (route exists but no navigation)
2. Forgetting `activate()` and `deactivate()` methods (both required)
3. Bundling React or @workspace/* packages (must be external)
4. Using hardcoded colors instead of semantic tokens
5. Naming a directory starting with `/api` (conflicts with Vite dev proxy)
6. Not filtering null values from GraphQL arrays

## Tech Stack

- React 19, TypeScript 5.5
- Tailwind CSS v4 with oklch color space
- shadcn/ui components
- TanStack Query (GraphQL), TanStack Router
- Vite 6, Turborepo
- pnpm workspaces
- Java/OSGi backend (Maven, Felix) for JAR plugin hosting
